method: Independent pandas raw key join plus finite disjoint depth counts; no parent feature builder/scorer. Reuses accepted official-throw contract and exact QB source-identity universe.
definition: FTN provider binary is_catchable_ball / is_drop / is_contested_ball annotation, TRUE/FALSE counted as known and missing as unknown. These are separate from observed complete_pass; no completion/catchability/drop identity assumed.
denominator: Each flag positive / explicitly known flag among eligible official credited non-sack/non-two-point throws, including incompletions; support coverage known / all eligible throws. All25down-depthcontexts remain in original contract; this review summarizes five depth bins.
difference_from_F1_F2: PriorF1/F2 appended eight-game aggregate chart support/age/three rates across all throws. New mechanism conditions annotation counts/rates on down/depth and integrates with pregame predicted context. It is not a repeated intercept or confidence gate.
five_week_rule: New exact law/direction/probability/policy must earn its own distinct scored season-weeks; four retained offered weeks do not inherit prior base or seven-week C point-replay history.
claim_limits: Provider charted catchable annotation is not pure QB accuracy, CP/CPOE or target-game predictor.
Current download/FTN date_pulled does not authenticate historical first availability.
Existing physical/stat-row universe remains retrospective participant membership, not a pregame roster.
New context fields must receive own later test against strongest same-mask retained controls; no positive gain presumed.
